title: Hello and Goodbye!
summary: Practise common English greetings and goodbyes for each day.
keyIdeas: Use Hello or Hi to greet someone, and Goodbye or Bye when leaving.
Say Good morning in the morning and Good night when going to bed.

activities.prompt: You arrive at school in the morning. What do you say?
activities.explanation: We say Good morning when greeting people in the morning.
activities.hint: It is the start of the morning.

activities.prompt: Complete the greeting when you see a friend in the park.
activities.explanation: We say Hello when meeting a friend.
activities.hint: Look for the greeting that means hola in Spanish.

activities.prompt: Match each greeting or goodbye to a similar reply.
activities.explanation: Hello and Hi are similar greetings. Goodbye and Bye-bye are ways to say goodbye.

activities.prompt: Sort these expressions into greetings and goodbyes.
activities.explanation: Hello, Hi and Good morning start a conversation. Goodbye, Bye-bye and See you are used when leaving.

activities.prompt: Hugo goes to bed at night. What does he say to his family?
activities.explanation: We say Good night when going to bed.
activities.hint: It is nighttime, and Hugo is going to sleep.

activities.prompt: Put these expressions in order through a day.
activities.explanation: First comes Good morning, then Good afternoon, and finally Good night at bedtime.

activities.prompt: School has finished for today. Complete the goodbye.
activities.explanation: We say Goodbye or Bye when leaving school.
activities.hint: It is time to go home.

activities.prompt: Read the story and answer the questions.
activities.explanation: The story shows greetings on arrival and goodbyes when school ends.
activities.title: At the School Gate
activities.text: Lucía arrives at school. She sees Omar. Lucía says: 'Good morning, Omar!' Omar smiles: 'Hello, Lucía!' Later, school finishes. Omar waves his hand: 'Goodbye, Lucía!' Lucía answers: 'Bye-bye, see you tomorrow!'

questions.prompt: What does Lucía say in the morning?
questions.explanation: At the start, Lucía says 'Good morning, Omar!'.

questions.prompt: What does Omar say when school finishes?

activities.prompt: Martina enters the classroom at nine in the morning. What does she say to her teacher?
activities.explanation: At nine in the morning, she politely says 'Good morning, teacher!'.
activities.hint: It is morning, and Martina is arriving at school.
